title.en: !{{Two voltage monitors are|Two voltage monitors are not}} more than [[percent]]% apart

titleFormatted.en: !{{[[monitor_a]] and [[monitor_b]] differ by more than|do not differ by more than}} [[percent]]%

hint.en: Compares the current reading of two Voltage monitors (e.g. two phases of a three-phase meter, watched as separate monitors) as a percent of their average: |A - B| / ((A + B) / 2) x 100. For more than two phases, chain this condition once per pair with AND/OR. False while either monitor has no reading yet.
